Senior Full-Stack Engineer

We are seeking an experienced full-stack engineer to join our growing team. You will be responsible for designing and building scalable web applications.

Requirements:
• 4+ years of experience with React and Node.js
• Strong understanding of system design and architecture
• Experience with AWS or GCP
• Proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript
• Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration
• Excellent communication and mentoring skills
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Nice to have:

• Knowledge of GraphQL
• Open-source contributions
